ws_address.description: IP address or hostname to bind the Cockpit web service to. Use `*` to listen on all network interfaces.

ws_port.description: TCP port on which the Cockpit web UI listens. Note: Cockpit listens on port 9090 by default and this cannot be changed in cockpit.conf.

ws_tls.description: Enable TLS (HTTPS) encryption for Cockpit connections. TLS is implicitly enabled when TLSCert/TLSKey are configured. To allow HTTP fallback, use ws_allow_unencrypted=false.

ws_tls_cert.description: File path to the TLS certificate used for HTTPS. Must be readable by the `cockpit-ws` user.

ws_tls_key.description: File path to the TLS private key. Must be secure and readable by `cockpit-ws`.

ws_cors_domains.description: List of origins permitted to make cross-origin requests to Cockpit. Leave empty or omit to disable CORS. The config key is `Origins` in section `[WebService]`.

ws_allow_unencrypted.description: If true, cockpit will accept unencrypted HTTP connections. Otherwise, HTTP is redirected to HTTPS. Defaults to false. This controls HTTP/HTTPS behavior when TLS is enabled.

login_banner.description: Show or hide the login banner. By default (per cockpit.conf(5)), no banner is displayed unless specified. Set to true to show it.

login_banner_text.description: Banner text shown on the login page. Empty string suppresses banner text. Not used unless Banner is true.

session_timeout_minutes.description: Session idle timeout in minutes (key: IdleTimeout). 0 disables timeout. Not recommended for production.

session_idle_timeout_minutes.description: Idle timeout in minutes before logging out due to inactivity. Set to 0 to disable. Note: IdleTimeout only applies to interactive password logins.

session_max_per_user.description: Maximum number of concurrent sessions per user. Set to 0 for unlimited. Not documented in cockpit.conf(5); may be handled via PAM or system limits.

session_recording_path.description: Absolute directory path where session recordings will be stored (e.g., `/var/log/cockpit`). Leave empty or omit to disable recording.

session_recording_exclude_users.description: List of usernames whose sessions should NOT be recorded. By default, all users (including root) are recorded if session recording is enabled.
